_note: Build recipes for every firmware arm in this directory, each VERIFIED to reproduce its md5 on 2026-08-07. These were recovered by exhaustive knob sweep: the arms were originally built with no provenance record, and DRFIX=1 / DRCOPRO_TUCK=1 are not guessable from the arm names. Build with experiments/cosim_farm/build_dbgpub.py <out.hex>, which pins the emitter modules to the worktree (a plain build resolves tuck_v3 from a SIBLING worktree -- see that file's docstring).
_common: All builds are dbg_build.py's `all 0` config: USE_DELTA=True, DEBUG_VAL1=False.

s20b.note: 2x2 arm A. DRCOPRO_TUCK=1 is v1's descriptor emitter; tuck_scan.py has ZERO STA_zp instructions and never writes D_BC/D_BO, so the PLACEMENT is the base search's. Clean base for any drop-mode comparison.

pre20.note: s20b with DRSTRAND unset = pre-#47 transfer arm. Also the hex committed on branch cosim-farm.

s20t3.note: 2x2 arms B and D. theta defaults to 150.

s20t3flash.note: The image embedded in the only timing-closed tier-3 rbf. CONFIRMS the documented confound: it lacks DRSTRAND=20, DRCHAIN=180, DRCOPRO_ARM=1 and DRFIX=1, so it is NOT s20t3.

dbg_ctl0.note: Byte-identical to s20t3 -- the guard proving DBGPUB does not leak into the shipped build.

dbg_pub1.note: MEASUREMENT ONLY, never flash: mailbox carries TK2_BBV and exit D_BV instead of a placement/descriptor.

dbg_pub2.note: MEASUREMENT ONLY, never flash: mailbox carries TK2_BBV and max D_V1 over all candidates; also destroys the descriptor by reusing TK2_APP/TK2_TRIG.

agree_l11.note: Copy of s20b used by the agreement gate.
